scope: Four ordinary practice trials across2old development seeds,2payout-only variants. No ranking or final.
hypothesis: A15%discount on unbundled driver payouts may reduce fulfillment cost without the extra demand induced by the earlier coupled lowfee experiment. Opening-only treatment preserves rescue willingness; full-curve treatment also reduces escalation and late-reset fees.
oldConfound: Earlier frontier-lowfee changed fee in both payout and customer quote cost/floor. It won382orders on seed15 compared with329in the current archived control, so its87.17%on-time outcome does not isolate lower driver payouts.

interventions.payout-full: Multiply all unbundled posted/repriced fee steps and corresponding direct offers by0.85, including late rescue.
interventions.payout-opening: Multiply only the ordinary initial unbundled fee by0.85. Preserve escalation, urgent and late-rescue steps.

invariants: Customer quote formulas, baseFee, demand cost estimates and initial admission rules are unchanged. Later realized admissions/prices can respond to changed bookings, capacity and trust.
Construct bundles from unchanged canonical schedules; bundle matching and bundled payout schedules are unaffected at identical states.
No extra reduction for the already-discounted bundles. Newly split unbundled legs follow the selected treatment.
No change to fee step clocks. Exactly one reduction per newly computed schedule.
baselineProvenance: Archived validated late-rescue16d. New default passes5614identical actions and clocks across3old event streams. Prior current-source controls reproduced full histories on both14/15.
selectionRule: Apply gate separately to each variant. If both pass, choose greater mean paired gain; break exact tie in favor of opening-only. No parameter sweep or rescue retuning against this screen.
freshValidation: Only after development gates pass; freeze a new independent paired panel. No default promotion on development results.
concurrencyReason: Another runner on the team key launches3world batches. Reserve3slots and still guard totalunfinished<4 before creating our next world.
failureRule: Retain every failed attempt. No silent replacement. Inspect every action error, drop, failed visit, refund and ledger total.
